checked_design: Complete state includes accumulated charges, history, pending I/O, elapsed ticks and budgets. Every continuation advances one tick, enabling finite acyclic evaluation.

Candidate targets use the fixed incumbent continuation law, with terminal anchoring and the declared 90/10 incumbent occupancy/uniform support mixture; no truth-law attribute is supplied to the narrow candidate context.
The old loader does load evaluator truth data in the same process. Audited dataflow and narrow interfaces are not a security sandbox; both facts are disclosed.
Five alpha values include exact no-edit and are scored as actually serialized F64 heads on all 64 TRAIN worlds. All five fits and all 100 candidates freeze before any new validation generation.
E and G share the fixed-feature 147-parameter quadratic, radius and five-alpha utility selection; G is gradient optimization, not a new base-model training replication.
EU and EA separately select from the identical predeclared finite alpha set using their own TRAIN utilities; no holdout-based ablation tuning is permitted.
R is one prespecified direction matched to the actually selected serialized E norm; a zero E edit requires R equal C.
P and J are explicit zero-weight-edit program controls. Their planning and verification costs are included, and their gains cannot be attributed to direct weight editing.

Validation fixes E/G gate choices and full chosen checkpoints before any test generation. Rejected candidates restore the exact canonical incumbent and deterministic compressed checkpoint bytes; accepted candidates have restoration marked inapplicable.
Both primary intervals use five reused fit-level paired differences and a two-comparison Bonferroni rule. World-arm counts are not treated as independent training replicates.

The paired Student-t intervals require distributional assumptions and are conditional on the reused training family; there are zero new training fits and no distribution-free or independent new-fit replication claim.

Historical content exclusion covers 2416 available unique schedules and all new schedules. Unavailable external trials and original formal-confirmation content remain unknown; collision stops instead of resampling.

Child process costs include startup and termination; controller clocks omit imports and final receipt writing. Base training, unknown history, agent work, transfer, energy and dollar costs are not inferred.

The independent verifier does not import the new graph or experiment worker. It checks fixed alpha identity, exact rational stored-point membership, arm completeness, all 100 candidate records, all 6400 TRAIN path/world replays and all 4960 held-out arm/world replays.
Independent replay shares the pinned task/law definitions; it is an independent traversal and head reduction, not independently authored environment semantics.
Local source hashes and event chains are tamper-evident records under retained bytes, not an external preregistration timestamp or trusted production transaction log.

final_cost_and_reporting_review.claims_reviewed: Endpoint solver ratio is not full training speedup; matched construction includes common preparation and selected checkpoint serialization only; cold J planning is additional to policy lookup; component costs are nested within full worker and must not be added to it. P/J are program controls, not pure-weight improvements. Historical and unmeasured controller/agent/economic costs remain unknown.

post_result_record_audit.audit_kind: Independent post-result record and statistical calculation; no model execution

posthoc_diagnostic_independent_record_au.interpretation: On these already exposed 48 fit23 OOD worlds, losses also occur under the checkpoint own law, and selected edited actions include negative one-step follow-C own advantages. This is a recorded head/target inconsistency. It neither proves a general capacity limit or absence of law error, nor demonstrates a repaired model or independent causal discovery of individual hidden-coordinate functions.

remaining_scientific_and_operational_lim: Both familywise primary lower bounds fail the required >.005 gain; exploratory raw IID gain cannot replace the fixed gated IID/OOD endpoint.
Validation accepted E/G only for fit23, while both TEST OOD gains for that fit are negative. The other four fits have exact incumbent gated behavior.
Eight validation-rejected model files were restored; the accepted fit23 research candidates remain saved. Overall TEST failure prevents qualification, not an observed production rollback.
P and J are program controls. Their results cannot be attributed to pure weight edits, and all secondary intervals remain descriptive.
No new training fits, no full-model retraining benchmark, no actual Trader benefit, no First-Passage/Reset or financial Call/Put validation, no production dtype replay.
The intervals are assumption-dependent conditional summaries across five reused fits; unknown prior selection is not removed by 2416 known-content exclusions.
Nested component clocks are not additive to whole-process totals. Historical/agent/editor/energy costs and controller startup/final-write overhead are not fully recoverable.
Any post-result localization is descriptive on already exposed data, must preserve source/weights/gates, and cannot create new confirmation evidence.
review_disposition: Accept as a reproducible negative scientific result and qualified record/replay demonstration. The prescribed pure-weight efficacy test failed. No productive weight repair or production installation is qualified.
review_requested_corrections_resolved: Reused_training_fit_count=5 and new_training_fit_count=0 replace ambiguous independence claims.
Accepted candidates have rejected_restoration_verified=null; rejected candidates require both canonical identity and complete compressed file identity.
Actual final E norm drives R, with predeclared relative tolerance 1e-10 and a zero-edit branch.
Per-candidate alpha and index must equal the frozen five-point list; path length, total candidate count, exact arm sets and complete replay counts are hard verifier gates.
Full NDU economic net gain is explicitly unqualified without a measured economic conversion for actual compute.
